STATIC EDITION

A vault for the moment.

This independent concept starts with 8 original sample artifacts. Create, edit, favorite, filter, move to trash and restore up to 20 artifacts per session. Source history holds up to 10 versions per artifact; metadata changes do not create source versions.

HTML and SVG are stripped to a static allowlist and shown in an isolated sandbox. CSS with imports or resource references is omitted. Preview scripts, links, forms and network access are disabled. Markdown supports headings, lists, emphasis and code. React and Mermaid remain source-only; other code is never executed.

Downloads contain original source, not the sanitized preview. Inspect files before opening or running them. Changes reset on refresh. This edition has no SQLite, API, MCP, AI, accounts or external services. It is not a secure repository or a production code sandbox.
